questions: Are the two opposite directions along a single axis (e.g., left/right on x-axis) or along two opposite vectors in 2D (e.g., north/south, east/west, or any angle)?
What is the step distance? Is it a constant unit length (e.g., 1) or variable?
Is the direction choice independent per step, or does it depend on previous direction?
Should the plot have any specific styling (line color, markers, title, axes labels, grid)?
Is the random walk constrained to integer coordinates?
Should the function close or show the plot, or just return the figure object?
What is the random number generator's seed? Should it be deterministic or truly random?
Are the directions chosen from a fixed set of two opposite vectors, or are they generated per step as a random angle?
